title: Current and Trail
author: Ines Nystrom
blurb: Astrid Hartwell, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
